description: Full preflight of one UBL Invoice or CreditNote: XML well-formedness, UBL 2.1 XSD, the official PINT AE Schematron (≈300 rules incl. the UAE jurisdiction overlay) or the ZATCA pre-check, plus advisory cross-checks. Returns a verdict and every finding with rule id, severity, fields, location and fix hint. Example: xml '<Invoice …>', jurisdiction 'auto'. Response: result with verdict (ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_WARNINGS | REJECTED), findings[] (id, severity, message, fields, location, fix_hint, source = xsd | schematron | preflight), counts, ruleset version and timings, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Documents are validated in memory and never stored or logged.

jurisdiction.description: 'ae' PINT AE Billing, 'ae-sb' PINT AE Self-Billing, 'sa' ZATCA (KSA), or 'auto' (from CustomizationID / ProfileID).
jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction

preflight.description: Also run the advisory Noah's Arch checks (nae-*/nksa-*: TRN/TIN consistency, emirate codes, VAT rates, totals cross-check, dates).
preflight.title: Preflight

xml.description: The UBL 2.1 Invoice or CreditNote XML as a string.
xml.title: Xml
